verified_facts: Front headlight replaced with a used original part
Front bumper replaced with an original part

objective.fallback_performance_goal: MAXIMIZE_NUMBER_OF_CONVERSATIONS only if the live account does not offer the lead goal and the downgrade is recorded

destination.continuity_message: Hi, I am interested in the Toyota Yaris 2026 for AED 54,000. Is it still available for inspection?

campaign_structure.randomization_method: META_AB_TEST_OR_EXPERIMENTS with 50/50 audience split; do not call ordinary uneven two-ad delivery a clean A/B test
campaign_structure.budget_level: AD_SET_BUDGETS_EQUAL; campaign budget optimization off for test isolation

locations.method: City location controls if available in the live account; no overlapping radius stack
locations.live_ui_check: Confirm Meta does not expand beyond selected location controls and record the exact presence/location option shown.

audience.language_strategy: English creative and copy; leave Meta language targeting open to avoid excluding multilingual UAE users. Record preferred lead language.
audience.detailed_targeting: BROAD; no automotive-interest narrowing in the first test
audience.exclusions: No customer-list Custom Audience until lawful basis, provenance and suppression are approved. Exclude employees only if an approved list exists.
audience.hypothesis: A bounded Ajman–Sharjah–Dubai catchment is more serviceable for an Ajman showroom than all-UAE targeting while retaining the largest nearby demand pools. This is a testable geography hypothesis, not established lead-to-sale evidence.

creative_integrity_controls: Disable enhancements that rewrite, animate, crop away or reorder the tested 0–2.4 second hook
Keep placement settings identical across arms
placements.reason: Meta currently recommends Advantage+ placements for budget efficiency; exact eligible placements for WhatsApp Leads must be verified in the live account.

creative_test.single_declared_difference: Opening 0–2.4 second hook: price-first versus repair/transparency-first. From 2.4 seconds onward, video, disclosure sequence, duration, audio, captions, CTA and landing conversation stay identical.
controlled_variables: all footage and overlays after 2.4 seconds
creative_test.creator_brief: Completed from the same Ad A master: only the visible 0–2.4 second black hook block was replaced. Duration, frame rate, resolution, no-audio state and all content after 2.4 seconds were preserved.

budget.basis: Planning floor of AED 30 per arm per day for 7 days. It is a constrained learning budget, not a guaranteed sample and not Meta's account minimum. Before approval compare with live estimated delivery; if either arm is unlikely to obtain decision-useful delivery, do not pretend the A/B test is powered.
budget.fallback_if_not_approved: Run Ad A only as a 7-day baseline at a separately approved cap of AED 140 (AED 20/day). Do not label that fallback an A/B test and do not infer A versus B.

schedule.no_early_winner_rule: Do not select a winner before the fixed 7-day checkpoint. Early pause is only for safety, truth, routing, availability or hard-cap failure.
schedule.launch_window_requirement: Start only when WhatsApp is staffed for the declared response window and both creatives are approved.

copy.primary_text: Toyota Yaris 2026 • GCC Specs • 4,546 km • AED 54,000. Previously damaged and repaired: used original front headlight, original front bumper replacement, and the bonnet was repaired and painted. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm availability and arrange an inspection.
copy.headline: Toyota Yaris 2026 — AED 54,000

tracking.arm_attribution: Prefer Meta/WhatsApp referral ad metadata. If unavailable, use arm-specific neutral source codes YA/YB in the prefilled message and record confidence; do not manufacture deterministic attribution.
tracking.analytics_join: analytics-observation.experiment_id + creative_id + platform/ad IDs + sales funnel lead_id

lead_capture.privacy_rule: Keep phone number and raw WhatsApp text in the authorized CRM/channel only; analytics records use privacy-safe IDs and classifications.

immediate_stop: Pause if vehicle is sold, reserved, unavailable, repriced or any material fact changes.
Pause if the ad or placement obscures the repair disclosure or changes the controlled hook.
Pause if WhatsApp routing, attribution or staffed response fails.
Pause at the exact approved hard cap; never auto-increase.
Pause for credible misleading-claim, policy, privacy or safety complaint.
decision_rules.evaluate: At day 7 compare qualified WhatsApp conversations by arm, cost per qualified conversation, qualification rate, appointment/inspection progression and placement mix. Message starts, CTR and video metrics are diagnostics.
decision_rules.iterate: If either arm has fewer than 10 attributable WhatsApp conversations or material execution imbalance, mark the creative comparison INCONCLUSIVE. Use the evidence to repair or request a separately approved extension; do not declare a winner.
decision_rules.scale: No autonomous SCALE. Require verified marginal business economics or an approved proxy threshold, delegated spend authority, current inventory, reliable downstream quality, operational response/appointment capacity and Strategist decision. Cheap messages alone cannot pass.
